 Follow Spider-Man Defies the Avengers to Take on Marvel’s Most Terrifying Hulk in New Preview
 Disita Sikdar Fri, October 30, 2026 at 6:46 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit - Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures A recent preview showcases Spider-Man fighting Hulk, even challenging the Avengers in the process. In Infernal Hulk Vs. Spider-Man #1, Bruce Banner transforms into a terrifying form while Peter Parker takes it upon himself to save the Fantastic Four and the citizens of New York.
 Taking such a step poses a serious risk to Spider-Man. With the Infernal Hulk on the loose, the superhero's mission could become deadly at any moment. Nevertheless, the friendly neighborhood hero chose to defy the Avengers' orders in an attempt to prevent the looming Age of Monsters.
 The comic was written by Phillip Kennedy Johnson and illustrated by Javier Pina. Rachelle Rosenberg and Yen Nitro contributed to the coloring, while Cory Petit handled the lettering. Nic Klein designed the cover.
 Infernal Hulk's attack has left the Fantastic Four & New York in ruins
 Marvel dropped a brand-new update centered on their Hulk comic series at the New York Comic Con. The Infernal Saga, created by Phillip Kennedy Johnson and Nic Klein, began with The Incredible Hulk #1 in 2023. The upcoming five-issue event series Hulk War: Infernal Rage will bring the saga to its conclusion.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In the comic book preview for Infernal Hulk vs. Spider-Man #1, New York City is in grave danger as it is now under the control of the Infernal Hulk. It is suggested that Hulk has attacked the Baxter Building, where he has defeated the Fantastic Four. The villain has also captured Reed Richards' children.
 Nic Klein reflected on the upcoming issue and stated, "This is the epic finale to Phillip and I's Hulk run that we started three years ago. In a perfect world, I would have liked to draw all issues of Incredible Hulk, which makes me drawing all of Hulk War so important to me."
 Infernal Hulk Vs. Spider-Man #1 will be available to fans on November 4, 2026. Hulk War: Infernal Rage, on the other hand, will release in February 2027.
